name: Brandy - Episode 1: The Plumber
source:
Ron the plumber has discovered his next client. The beautiful busty babe, Brandy. He will give it his best to check out her plumbing.  Is his toolbox a match to go against our favorite lovable lady?

[From [url=https://johnnorth.itch.io/brandy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
水管工罗恩迎来了他的下一位客户——丰满迷人的大美人布兰迪。他将使出浑身解数，好好检修一番她的“管道”。他手中的工具箱，能否招架得住这位惹人喜爱的魅力女郎呢？
